task_definition.task_description: Please look up information for the Hilton Tokyo and check the weather alerts for Tokyo, Japan, then send that weather alert card to me via email with high priority. After that, book a business class flight CA1234 for Alice Smith, convert the timestamp 1729764000 to a readable date, and use it to schedule a "Travel Itinerary Review" meeting with alice@company.com and bob@company.com at 10:00. Finally, create a backup of my /projects/travel_plans workspace named "Tokyo_Trip_Backup".

user_input.query: Hi, I'm user u_12345. Could you please look up some information for the Hilton Tokyo and check for any weather alerts in Tokyo, Japan? I’d like you to send that weather alert card to me via email with high priority. Once that's done, please book business class flight CA1234 for Alice Smith. I also need you to convert the timestamp 1729764000 into a readable date and use it to schedule a "Travel Itinerary Review" meeting at 10:00 with alice@company.com and bob@company.com. Finally, please create a backup of my /projects/travel_plans workspace and name the file "Tokyo_Trip_Backup". Thank you!
